Chroma 19032 Overview

Ground Continuity Lead Set
Power Entry Adapter
AC Power Cable
8A 250V Power Line Fuse
HV Lead, 1M (x2)
Corded Product Adapter (240V)
8V Fuse x2
4V Fuse x2
Calibration Certificate
Manual
Electrical safety testing is a major item in electrical product quality testing. All electrical products like adapters, SMPS, charges, house appliances, information technology products, and video products are required to undergo electrical safety testing.
The Chroma 19032 combines Hipot, Insulation Resistance (IR), Ground Bond (GB), Leakage Current (LC)/AC LC/DC LC and Dynamic Function Tests. Space savings can be up to 50% of production line space, through not purchasing multiple safety test instruments. The 19032 is able to increase the efficiency of electrical safety testing during manufacturing and reduce associated labor costs.
Chroma 19032 Applications:
The 19032 can be used in a variety of scenarios, which include quality assurance sample inspection testing, manufacturing testing, and development validation. Some example products are:
Power cords
House appliances
Information technology products
Medical equipment
Lab/testing equipment
